name: Wayward! Exploration
intro: Sword-and-sorcery exploration. Human wanderers use guile, practical skill and nerve. The Silent Tollhouse is a short outdoor investigation with no combat encounters. This adaptation supports task checks and persistent discoveries only. All equipment and character abilities are fixed pregens.

classes.name: Merchant
classes.description: A human merchant drawn into the mystery at the tollhouse.
classes.kit: Knife, short spear, light armor, writing materials, rope and lantern; backpack, waterskin and food and water for three days. Equipment is fixed for this playtest.

classes.name: Burglar
classes.description: A human burglar drawn into the mystery at the tollhouse.
classes.kit: Knife, sword, light armor, lockpick tools, crowbar and rope; backpack, waterskin and food and water for three days. Equipment is fixed for this playtest.

terrain.name: Open water
terrain.note: Dropships may hover here. Impassable to ground units.

terrain.name: Wide water
terrain.note: Lakes and wide rivers. Impassable to ground units.

terrain.name: Beach
terrain.note: Embarkation point when adjacent to open water.

terrain.name: Dense urban
terrain.note: Short sight lines. Contacts are hard to detect.

terrain.name: Hills
terrain.note: Elevated. Good for observation and comms relays.

attribution: Wayward!, by George Zackrison, based on Barbaric! Second Edition by Omer Golan-Joel and incorporating material by Omer Golan-Joel, Richard Hazlewood, Josh Peters, and Robert Garitta.
adaptation: Selected task rules and human narrative-archetype pregens for an asynchronous exploration playtest; see docs/wayward.md for omissions and playtest conventions.
